set.prevailing_wage_basis: False for the County conduit bond issuance itself: DIR Public Works Case No. 2006-001, Horizons at Indio (March 12, 2007), https://www.dir.ca.gov/OPRL/coverage/year2007/2006-001.pdf, held that multifamily housing revenue bonds issued by a conduit issuer, with proceeds and repayments assigned to a private trustee and no issuer liability, are not a payment of public funds under Labor Code 1720(b)(1) and are not a below-market public loan under 1720(b)(4); same holding in PW 2003-042, UC Irvine East Campus (July 28, 2006), citing PW 2004-016 Rancho Santa Fe. The County program page and Debt Policy state the bonds involve no pledge of County revenues, taxes or assets. Current Labor Code 1720(b)(1) and (b)(4) text (california.public.law) is unchanged in substance. Any County, HOME, CDBG, Measure X or other public loan in the same deal is analyzed separately and may trigger state prevailing wage or Davis-Bacon.
set.audit_note: Prevailing wage set false on DIR conduit-bond determinations PW 2006-001 and PW 2003-042; covers bond issuance only, not companion public loans; determinations are fact-specific and predate later 1720(c) amendments, which do not affect the 1720(b)(1) holding.

reason: DIR coverage determinations hold that conduit-issued multifamily revenue bonds are not public funds under Labor Code 1720(b), so the bond issuance alone does not trigger prevailing wage.
